_rule: Prepared BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). STAGED, not queued, not authorized. One Water Queens House (S8) launch, Ultra with fg=3, the RTX Hair On bundle of 6i (rt_hair_header_scene_pass=1 inside it; a second scene pass of a present interval gets its own header and tag), detailed logging. Not bundle keys: rt_hair_card_fill=1 and rt_hair_dense_sample=1 are compiled into the strand pipelines at startup (the fill's header flag is off in every gated window), rt_hair_coverage_keep is toggled inside the run, and the last windows turn rt_hair_header_scene_pass off (the control).

result_hx1_190905.run: captures/queue/logs/hx1-s8-hair-stable.1.190905.log, VALID, 19 of 19 phases, 195 s. Window occluded (336 of 336 checks): no frame time or presented image is judged.
result_hx1_190905.key_off: header pass line with rt_hair_header_scene_pass 0: 'label taken by the decal pass' 31 and 42 of 60 frames while still (load), 165 of 217 (in-base) and 131 of 183 (out-base): the hair traced the publish before in 52-76% of all frames, not rarely. in-base: 6 frame watchdog trips, 9 strands->cards (all frame watchdog), 29 of 181 frames with every draw on cards, 14 dropouts, 51 own-bound fails; out-base: 3 trips, 12 switches, 29 frames on cards, 6 dropouts, 38 own-bound fails. Dense samples moving: accepted 71% / no strand 15.7% (in-base, 1013) and 61% / 25.1% (out-base, 1120); still 80-84% / 4.5-6.4%. All 8 watchdog lines (G-buffer frames 4047-4053, 4224, 4229) are in these two windows, each 'applied the publish of build frame N - 1'.
result_hx1_190905.key_on: 24 period lines with rt_hair_header_scene_pass 1 (still, 4 dollies of 180 frames, 3 of 60, 2 orbits): 'label taken by the decal pass 0', 'at the decal pass 0' and 'by another scene pass 0' in every one; frame watchdog trips 0, key watchdog 0, coverage low 0, coverage high 0, 0 frames with every draw on cards, dropouts 0, own-bound fails 0 in every one. Fill off: in-fix 0 strands->cards, 3 cards->strands, 181 of 181 hair frames on strands, strand share 0.954, moving accepted 81% / no strand 4.0% (1203 samples; still 81% / 5.0%); out-fix 0 and 2, 181 of 181, 0.932, moving 81% / 4.1% (1306; still 85% / 4.9%). Fill on: in-fill 1 strands->cards, out-fill 1, pre-in 1; orbit-r, orbit-l, watch-fill, watch-off 0. The moving shares equal the still ones: the loss under motion is gone.
result_hx1_190905.residual_switches: The 3 strands->cards switches with the key are all 'coverage stale/none/invalidated', all key 22a2 (a head at x 1850-1900 of 2560 before the dolly in, off the screen or hidden after it): in-fill 47 frames as strands, card pixels 2869 down to 2, then no card pixel in the counted frames; 28 frames (kHoldFrames) later its evidence is 'stale' and it draws cards unseen for the rest of the window (135 'coverage stale' G-buffer refusals against 24 in in-fix, where the head stayed in view at 603 pixels). Not a loss: a draw with no card pixel on screen. The visible part is the way back: every head that comes into view again (or for the first time) shows its cards for 8-10 frames until a probe measurement is read: 2-3 cards->strands switches per dolly with card runs of 10 frames (in-fix: keys 12e9, b513, dcbc; out-fix: 9cfc, e9fa; out-fill: 22a2 at 329-2281 card pixels).
result_hx1_190905.hitch: No frame with two scene passes in one present interval in this run ('by another scene pass 0' in all 30 period lines, also during the 8 LOD decodes of 47-78 ms in pre-in). hx1 180928 had 2 in its first dolly (6 decodes).
result_hx1_190905.gates_quiet: With the key the worst used ratio of a draw of 64 card pixels or more stayed 0.017-0.097 above its own bound in every window; 'draws outside their own footprint bounds' 0. No threshold changed.
result_hx1_190905.cost: strand G-buffer draws 0.31 ms (in-fix, 29 timed frames). The key is CPU only.

observable: (1) The bundle alone keeps the strands in every frame of the wheel dolly and the orbit: no gate switches a head to cards. (2) rt_hair_coverage_keep removes the remaining strands->cards switches (a draw off the screen) and the card frames of a head that comes back into view. (3) The control without rt_hair_header_scene_pass shows the decal pass taking labels in the same run.
windows: warmup 20 s, warm-ab 3 s (fill 1, scene pass 0, keep 1), warm-on 3 s; pre-in, pre-out (120 frames, wheel +10 / -10, unjudged: the near LODs upload); bundle alone: settle-on, in-on, out-on (180 frames, wheel), orbit-r, orbit-l (180 frames, 60 px/s from the first second), still-on (60 frames, PNG), in-shot (120 frames, wheel +10), shot-on (PNG 0.1 s after the dolly window), out-shot; settle-keep, in-keep, out-keep (keep 1, 180 frames); settle-fill, still-fill (PNG), in-fill, shot-fill (PNG), out-fill (fill 1); settle-base, in-base, out-base (scene pass 0).

part1_bundle.keys: the RTX Hair On bundle of common/settings.h, nothing else that changes a decision (card fill flag 0, keep 0)
part1_bundle.predicted_header: in-on, out-on, orbit-r, orbit-l, in-shot, out-shot, still-on, shot-on: 'applied at the scene G-buffer pass N' (N near the window's frames, more when a settle window precedes), 'at the decal pass 0', 'label taken by the decal pass 0', 'by another scene pass 0'. 'second scene passes of an interval with their own header and tag' 0 to 2 per window (one per hitch; 0 in all of 190905).
part1_bundle.predicted_strands: the same windows: switches line with frame watchdog 0, key watchdog 0, coverage low 0, coverage high 0, coverage latched 0, header not applied 0, live toggle 0, other 0; 0 frames with every draw on cards; frame watchdog trips 0, key watchdog trips 0. 'coverage stale/none/invalidated' 0 or 1 per moving window (a draw that left the screen for 28 frames; 190905: 1 in 3 of 7), 0 in the still windows. cards->strands 2-3 per dolly with card runs near 10 frames. Dense samples moving: accepted 80% or more, no strand 4-6%, as still.
part1_bundle.if_it_fails: a watchdog trip or a low-coverage switch with 'label taken by the decal pass 0' and 'by another scene pass 0': not the header; read that window's dense samples (reason shares) and its watchdog line (applied publish, rebase origin). 'by another scene pass' above 0 would mean a second scene pass in the same command buffer recording (the layer only gives another recording its own header).

part2_keep.key: rt_hair_coverage_keep=1 (CPU only, live, off by default): coverage evidence does not expire by age; the last measurement stays the verdict until a newer one, an invalidation, a latch or a watchdog replaces it.
part2_keep.predicted: in-keep, out-keep: ' 0 strands->cards' with every cause 0, 0 frames on cards, frame watchdog trips 0. cards->strands 0 or 1 per dolly (only a key never measured before: 'coverage none'), against 2-3 with the bundle alone; G-buffer refusals 'coverage stale' 0 on the frame line. Strand share and dense shares as in part 1.
part2_keep.if_it_holds: add rt_hair_coverage_keep to the On bundle (one line in common/settings.h). If a key trusted from an old verdict fails after coming back (coverage low in these windows), keep the key off and report the key's ratios.

part3_card_fill.keys: the card fill's header flag (rt_hair_card_fill=1; specialization 1053 compiled in at startup)
part3_card_fill.record: still-fill against still-on and shot-fill against shot-on: full-width PNGs (2560), the same camera states (zoomed out and still; a second after the dolly in). With the fill the 4-5% of card pixels without a strand show the card; look for a seam at the hair outline and for a difference right after the motion (predicted: none beyond the still one, since the moving loss is gone).
part3_card_fill.predicted: still-fill, in-fill, shot-fill, out-fill: frame watchdog 0, key watchdog 0, coverage low 0 (reported, as in 180928 and 190905). Cost: strand G-buffer GPU ms of still-fill within the noise of still-on (190905: 0.31 ms; 180928: 0.30 against 0.39 ms).

part4_control.predicted: in-base, out-base: 'label taken by the decal pass' 1 or more (190905: 165 of 217 and 131 of 183), 3-12 frame watchdog trips per dolly, 28-frame card periods, moving 'no strand' 15-25%.

not_gated: the control's trips, the dropout counts, the fill windows' switches, cards->strands counts and the GPU ms are reported.
target: the user's target is strands in every frame of a converted style, also under fast camera motion, with no card/strand flipping. Part 1 is that target for every cause the bundle answers; part 2 closes the last cause seen in 190905 (off-screen draws) and is what the bundle would gain next. A style or LOD without a groom file keeps its cards (S8 has 2 such draws per frame: index counts 3399 and 7086 in 190905).
